name: decoder_wgs_parallel_prefix_v1
hypothesis: Parallelize WGS cost-prefix and range computation over the existing x-producer warp, replacing its serial lane-0 prologue. Preserve the incumbent cost table, unit weights, arithmetic, and all other kernels. This ports the high-value stream-K prologue technique documented in keell0renz public decoder while isolating it from their additional changes.
screen: paired exact-parent judge-image H200, sliding decode/verify batches 1/16/32, two seeds

screen_result.caveat: small batch-1 regressions; aggregate paired gain is only about 0.10%, so this is not yet a confirmed leaderboard improvement

full_shape_paired_screen.caveat: single seed and eight paired rounds: supports only a small ~0.23% aggregate gain; official scored draw was 2.20152x and remains below incumbent

followup: The initially positive screen was too narrow to establish promotion; broader full+sliding screen is only +0.23% and conflicts with lower official score. Require repeated paired seeds before reconsidering.
